name: pheno
absorption_note: Canonical parent for the public Pheno Rust workspace. Keep its 11 workspace members and crate boundaries explicit; do not flatten member repositories or infer absorption from shared naming.
rationale: Active public Rust monorepo described as 170K+ LOC with 11 workspace members, including AgilePlus, phenoDesign, and PhenoLibs. Registering the parent closes a major registry boundary gap while preserving member-level provenance.
